name: generic default, blue
note: The seventeen brand slots (vois-tokens DS-TOKEN-004) for the generic default theme: thirteen colors, primary and accent both blue, with white text on a primary fill from blue-10 so the 14 and 16px labels meet 4.5:1 (white on blue-9 is about 3.5:1), and four font families as generic system stacks (the written font inherits, because a generic cursive renders as Comic Sans on Windows). A product's own brand goes in its own brand file, built with build-tokens.mjs --brand, never here.
